Olivia (CSM): Heads up — Helio Data asking for a temporary per-route QPS bump for their Brazil launch tomorrow 09:00 BRT. Need IP exemptions + regional routing. @Jorge can we do per-route overrides instead of account-wide?
Priya (Helio): Yes. We only need /api/v1/ingest from 200 -> 1000 qps and /api/v1/stream from 200 -> 800 qps for ~6h. Traffic will come from São Paulo region. Also, renewal is coming up next month — want to avoid throttles during launch.
Olivia (CSM): Requesting CIDR exemption for 18.5.32.0/24 and 18.5.33.0/24. Per-route rules: /api/v1/ingest=1000, /api/v1/stream=800. Auto-revoke at 15:00 UTC same day. Can we set the rate window to 6h with an autorevoke tag?
Jorge (NetEng): We can do a per-route override for hosted API. Note: this won't affect Private (on-prem) unless peering is in place. I'll provision as "temp-brazil-launch-helio" and tag for auto-revoke.
Marta (Oncall): Adding oncall to the window. Monitoring thresholds: alert if 5xx > 0.5% OR latency P95 > 800ms. @peering-bot please run peering pre-check (ASN/traceroute) so we know routing is solid.
peering-bot: peering-bot: New peering check started for Helio Data. Status: waiting on customer ASN and traceroute sample.
Priya (Helio): ASN is 64512. Sample traceroute (truncated):
traceroute to 34.123.45.67 (34.123.45.67), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  1.123 ms  1.045 ms  1.010 ms
 2  192.0.2.1  10.102 ms  10.055 ms  10.012 ms
 ...
We'll switch to hosted routing for the launch.
Jorge (NetEng): Created ticket INF-3421, applied config to staging for smoke tests. Command used:
```
redwoodctl rate-override create --name temp-brazil-launch-helio \\
  --cidrs 18.5.32.0/24,18.5.33.0/24 \\
  --routes /api/v1/ingest=1000,/api/v1/stream=800 \\
  --start 2026-03-24T09:00:00-03:00 --end 2026-03-24T15:00:00Z
```
Will roll to prod after quick sanity checks.
Olivia (CSM): :thumbsup: Thanks. Priya, please confirm start time in UTC so we lock the schedule. Also flagging renewal team — this launch is a good touchpoint for renewal discussions.
Priya (Helio): Confirmed: start 12:00 UTC (09:00 BRT). We'll ramp traffic over ~30 minutes. Renewal team is available for a call next week.
Marta (Oncall): Monitoring hooks added. Auto-rollback criteria: if error budget > 2% in first 10m or P95 > 1s, we roll back to default QPS and notify the thread. I'll paste rollback command if triggered.
Jorge (NetEng): Prod rollout scheduled 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z. Tags: temporary, autorevoke, per-route. INF-3421 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421
Olivia (CSM): Action items: 1) Jorge -> prod rollout at 12:00 UTC, 2) Marta -> oncall monitoring + rapid rollback, 3) Priya -> peering confirmation + ASN/traceroute, 4) Olivia -> renewal follow-up. I'll update Helio post-launch. :rocket:
Priya (Helio): Thank you — we may request a diagnostic snapshot after ~2h into the window (P95, token-cost delta). Please keep the window open until autorevoke.
Marta (Oncall): Noted. I'll capture P95/P99, 5xx rate, and token-level cost impact. Will close thread after auto-revoke and post a short postmortem if anything abnormal shows up.
